scope: Native LaTeX migration completeness, research-evidence preservation, compiled-document metadata/log/citation checks and sampled visual PDF inspection; not fresh experiment verification.

checks.bibliography_format_only_change: Title fields protected with an additional brace layer; title lexical content and all other source fields unchanged. CSL comparison ignores reader-derived title-short and title capitalization.

required_boundaries_retained: B minus C0 gains are separated from C3 contribution.
C3 minus B is negative on M4 (-1.8108 pp), positive on M5 (+0.9273 pp), with both original family intervals retained.
B remains the adopted default; no configuration-specific winner substitution.
Development exposure remains explicit; independent family confirmation and a second F pool remain unexecuted.
A1/A2 share a rule kernel; rule ablations retain 123-input denominator.
A4 has zero clinical-v5 coverage; 24 profiles x 12 historical questions are a separate conditional-model panel.
M4/M5 output protocols differ as well as backbone.
Unknown common C0/retrieval costs and missing timing remain identified; physical and method-attributed request ledgers are not conflated.
No invented authors, affiliations, funding status, ethics approvals, conference acceptance or clinical validation.
intentional_editorial_differences: Automatic LaTeX labels and references replace manual numbering; added brief figure/table navigation.
Data/code declaration now reflects the published private GitHub repository and required authorized access.
Reproduction paragraph now describes native LaTeX/BibTeX build instead of Markdown/Pandoc rendering.
Bibliography title case is protected without changing title lexical content or reference identity.

verification_method: Read manuscript/method statements; parse both sources with installed Pandoc 3.9 for independent text/table comparison only (Pandoc is not the manuscript build engine); compare source labels, real citep keys, formulas and figure hashes.
audit_attempt_notes: Two initial ad-hoc comparison commands had a Python parenthesis syntax error before reading/writing results; corrected comparator completed successfully.
Pandoc LaTeX reader treats multiline table headers as extra rows; data-row comparison selects original row identifiers and checks every data cell.

Initial bibliography comparison flagged intended title capitalization and reader-derived title-short differences; corrected comparison normalizes those presentation-only effects and matches all fields.

Intermediate third layout build introduced 17 pt minipage paragraph-indent overflow; identified in independent log check and reported to primary agent. Final build removes it with noindent; final log has no overflow/warning lines.

pdf_audit.creator: LaTeX with hyperref
pdf_audit.visual_findings: Final pages 9 and 17 viewed directly: paired-effect table, forest plot, historical explicit-model table and their captions are readable and inside page bounds; M4 negative and M5 positive effects retained; no clipping or overlap observed. Intermediate page 8 main results also reviewed. All-page final visual review performed separately by primary agent.

final_layout_changes_reviewed.description: Final main.tex removes unused inputenc, reduces paragraph spacing and gives Appendix C a clear page; reproduction pseudocode is enclosed in a no-indent minipage to keep it together. Content/evidence statements unchanged.
